api.description: Adapter family to use for this provider.

doc.description: Docs link for this provider's model list.

env.description: Env-var names consulted for credentials, in priority order. The first element is the conventional one (`OPENAI_API_KEY` etc.); downstream entries are fallbacks.

Cost.description: Per-tier cost. Values are USD per **million tokens** (models.dev convention). Optional fields are only present when the provider publishes distinct pricing for that axis.

ModelInfo.description:
Metadata for one model. One-to-one with the models.dev `Model` schema. Loaded lazily per-provider via `getModel(id)` or eagerly via `listModels()`.

Runtime invariant enforced by the catalog (not by the TS type): when `reasoning === false`, `cost.reasoning` is absent.

api.description: adapter to use: anthropic, openai, openai-responses, etc.

contextSize.description: Max context size for this model

cost.description: Pricing per million tokens. `context_over_200k` is the higher tier some providers bill for prompts over 200K tokens.

last_updated.description: Last catalog update in `YYYY-MM` or `YYYY-MM-DD`. Informational.

maxTokens.description: Max output tokens this model accepts

open_weights.description: Model weights are publicly released. Informational.

reasoning_options.description: Provider-specific controls. Optional for older catalogs and custom models.

tool_call.description: Supports tool calling. Informational — we filter non-tool models out of the generated catalog, so at runtime this is effectively always true. Optional to make `addModels` ergonomic.

Quirks.description:
Provider-specific wire quirks that "OpenAI compatibility" doesn't actually cover. Each field names an axis of variation with a typed union of known shapes; adapters read these and dispatch.

Populated by `getModel` from `assets/quirks.json` — provider-level defaults overlaid with per-model overrides. Users can further override per-model via `addModels` or per-call via the request's `quirks` field.

Add new axes here as they surface; start minimal.

friendlyErrors.description: Friendly-error formatting for known endpoint shapes. `"codex"` parses ChatGPT usage-limit responses into a human message.

maxTokensField.description:
Which wire field carries the max-output-tokens cap, per adapter family.

Chat Completions:   - `"max_tokens"`            — legacy, most third-parties   - `"max_completion_tokens"` — newer OpenAI + reasoning models

Responses:   - `"max_output_tokens"`     — public Responses API default

All families:   - `"none"` — suppress entirely. Codex backend rejects any     max-tokens field with `Unsupported parameter`.

reasoningField.description:
Streaming delta field that carries reasoning tokens.
- `"reasoning"` (OpenRouter, most third-parties)
- `"reasoning_content"` (DeepSeek-ish)
- `"reasoning_details"` (structured form on a few providers) If unset, adapter accepts any of the three.

reasoningLevels.description: Which effort levels this model actually accepts. Adapter clamps unsupported values to the nearest supported one — `"xhigh"` on pre-GPT-5.4 → `"high"`, `"minimal"` on o1/o3 → `"low"`. Unset means any level is accepted.

responsesInclude.description: Extra fields to request on the response payload. Codex backend needs `["reasoning.encrypted_content"]` so the model can round-trip reasoning across turns.

responsesReasoningSummary.description: Reasoning summary verbosity for the Responses API. Default `"auto"`. `"off"` disables the summary stream.

responsesStore.description: Whether the Responses API persists the response server-side (`store`). Default `true`. Codex backend requires `false`.

responsesSystemAs.description:
Where the durable system prompt lands.
- `"input"` (default) — first item, `role: "system"` message.
- `"instructions"` — top-level `instructions` field. Codex backend   rejects system messages in `input` and requires this.

sessionHeader.description: Header carrying the conversation identity. Independent of prompt caching.

strictTools.description: Model supports `strict: true` on tool definitions. Default false.

temperatureSupported.description: Model accepts `temperature`. Default derived from `ModelInfo.temperature` (catalog field); set here to override.

thinkingFormat.description:
How the provider expects reasoning / thinking requests shaped.
- `"openai"`              → `reasoning_effort: "minimal|low|medium|high"`
- `"openrouter"`          → `reasoning: { effort }`
- `"deepseek"`            → `thinking: { type: "enabled" }` + `reasoning_effort`
- `"zai"` / `"qwen"`      → top-level `enable_thinking: boolean`
- `"qwen-chat-template"`  → `chat_template_kwargs.enable_thinking`

ReasoningOption.description: Reasoning controls advertised by models.dev for a provider/model.
